Definition: properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of
BiblicalUsage: subst; 1) be in front of; adv; 2) in front of, opposite to, in the sight of, before, to the front, right on; prep; 3) towards the front of, in front of, on behalf of, as far as in front of
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
